name: singleplayer-harness
description: Emulator harnesses for the single-player game family. NOT a build unit: functions/ and frontend/ each have their own package.json and are what get deployed. This root package exists solely to hold the browser driver the .mjs harnesses use. ⚠ EVERY HARNESS BUILDS functions/ FIRST. emulators:exec serves functions/lib, so without it a harness silently runs the PREVIOUS compile and reports a green suite for code that was never executed — which happened, 08-03. Applied to all six games on 08-03; before that only the caller's discipline stood between a stale lib and a false green.

scripts.harness:pd: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node pd-playthrough.mjs"
